source: knowledge/web/effects-materials.md sections 2.2-3.3 (measured 2026-10-10, 32 sites, raw in knowledge/benchmarks/effects/raw/*.json); extends type-hierarchy-buttons-shadows.md 3.13-3.14 (Geist/Clerk/AlignUI stacks) instead of replacing it
light_direction: top, x = 0 on every layer (web UI convention: 30 of 32 measured sites; Apple Store 2px 4px and Untitled UI 18px 26px are the only x offsets)

ink.why: cool near-black; Stripe 50 50 93, Attio 0 22 62 / 11 13 24, Clerk 19 19 22, AlignUI 41 41 41, Cal 34 42 53. Retint per brand: hue of the canvas, L about 10-20%.

constraints.founder: cards and chips: blur <= 24px and alpha <= .16 per layer; one shadow language per site (<= 3 distinct shadow strings across product visuals)
constraints.animate: never transition a layered box-shadow; fade a pre-rendered ::after (opacity) or move the element (transform)

tiers.name: resting
tiers.use: cards on the canvas, inputs, table frames, secondary buttons
anchors: Linear dark card inset white ring

tiers.name: raised
tiers.use: hovered cards, chips, toasts, sticky toolbars, floating side cards in a hero

tiers.name: floating
tiers.use: popovers, menus, dropdowns, tooltips over content, floating product cards

tiers.name: overlay
tiers.use: dialogs, command palette, sheets: the one surface above everything

tiers.name: hero frame
tiers.use: the product window / showcase frame in a hero (one per page); exempt from the 24px card cap like Stripe's frame
tiers.light: 0 0 0 1px rgb(var(--sh-ink) / .06), 0 1px 1px -.5px rgb(var(--sh-ink) / .05), 0 3px 3px -1.5px rgb(var(--sh-ink) / .05), 0 6px 6px -3px rgb(var(--sh-ink) / .05), 0 12px 12px -6px rgb(var(--sh-ink) / .05), 0 24px 24px -12px rgb(var(--sh-ink) / .05), 0 48px 48px -24px rgb(var(--sh-ink) / .04)
anchors: Linear dark frame 0 2px 32px .25 + black ring .2 + inset white .05

contact.why: Cal.com's crisp bottom edge: a tight, high-alpha layer with spread -4px only shows as a 1px dark line under the bottom edge; pairs with a soft 0 4px 8px .05

highlight_light.why: top catch-light for white/grey surfaces sitting on a grey canvas (Clerk inset white .8 at .5px, Cal inset 0 2px 0 #fff on light buttons)

highlight_dark.why: Linear .04, Supabase .04, Raycast .05-.10, Raycast window .3 at .5px

ring_tray.why: Granola's tray halo: a wide 0-blur spread at 5% hue-tinted ink makes a soft outer frame without a second element (6px and 8px measured)

ambient_light.why: Lightfield's only shadow: one very wide, very faint ambient layer over a 1px border; reads as air, not as a drop

accent_button.value: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .18), inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .12), 0 1px 2px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 35%, transparent), 0 2px 6px -1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 30%, transparent)
accent_button.why: coloured shadow under a coloured fill: Framer #09f 0 1px 2px .15 + 0 2px 4px .2, Attio #266df0 0 2px 4px -2px .12 + 0 3px 6px -2px .08, Evervault violet 0 2px 15px .2 over black contact layers

keycap_dark.value: 0 1.5px .5px 2.5px rgb(0 0 0 / .4), 0 0 .5px 1px rgb(0 0 0), inset 0 2px 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / .25), inset 0 1px 1px 1px rgb(255 255 255 / .2)
